clips.title: The story
paras: Ahanu's Leather Goods carries Thunder Bluff's leatherwork to the Crossroads. Ahanu sends finished leather armor and supplies to the Barrens for travelers there.

Ahanu prepares leather goods for trade beyond Mulgore. In Thunder Bluff, the leatherworker turns raw hides into finished apparel and gear for Jahan Hawkwing, a merchant at the Crossroads in the Barrens. The plains make overland travel slow, so the tauren send the parcel by air. Tal and Devrak's trained wind riders carry goods swiftly across long distances.
